title: history
description: Stored reports, oldest first, from Core's append-only log. report picks one kind (telemetry gives the path flown); since and until limit the time. With asset_id on the query, one Asset's past path over a time range is one message. Leave any out to get everything. Core sends the matching messages and then its admin.reply, which marks the end: an accepted reply with nothing before it means nothing matched.
